name: Stance: Twisting Petal Stance

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Granted by Twisting Petal Stance

You can make gale blossom strikes that deal 1d6 slashing damage. These strikes are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, shove, and unarmed traits.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Shove and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC to avoid being Shoved. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Feint and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC to resist an opponent's Feint attempt.
